english: While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.
text: 借钱的方向要看谁把钱交出去：这里我请托尼 lend me twenty pounds，是让他借给我。换成从自己的角度讲，可说 I asked to borrow twenty pounds from him；while 只是交代开口时他正在吃饭。
